notes.title: Dragon Kingdom Ground Up
notes.notes:
Hello fellow gamers,

I am switching from Godot to Unity and redoing Dragon Kingdom from the ground up. Now is an excellent to join the discord to get more frequent updates and discuss with us potentially features. Some things in Dragon Kingdom may change from its current version. Once done with the switch to Unity and Dragon Kingdom is reprogrammed, new features will be included and will allow for more features to be added in the future. I am excited about this change and hope you all enjoy what we have in store. https://discord.gg/TmVNc6STNb

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
-Crops can no longer be planted where other crops are
-Dialog works properly
-NPCs no longer face only left
-Game doesn't crash when talking to NPC while holding item
-Shops properly subtract required resources
-Crops and dragon properly age

[b]Quality of Life Changes:[/b]
-Shipping bin shows total value of all items in it
-White square to show where player is interacting
-Changed interact button to E
-Changed inventory button to I
-ESC opens Controls panel
